label.purpose: Navigation, filters, status, and short metadata.

motion.name: tactical-ease

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(82% 0.22 126); color: oklch(7% 0.012 135); padding: 11px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; clip-path: polygon(5px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 5px),calc(100% - 5px) 100%,0 100%,0 5px); font: 700 12px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(90% 0.25 126); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(90% 0.25 126); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary path beside one primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(9% 0.01 130); color: oklch(94% 0.008 120); padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid oklch(72% 0.02 120); border-radius: 2px; font: 700 12px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(82% 0.22 126); color: oklch(82% 0.22 126); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(90% 0.25 126); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(45% 0.025 120); border-radius: 0; background: oklch(14% 0.014 135); color: oklch(94% 0.008 120); font: 400 14px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus { outline: 3px solid oklch(90% 0.25 126); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: oklch(82% 0.22 126); }

components.name: Product Bay
components.description: Recessed catalog surface with image, availability, title, and price.
components.css: .ds-product { width: 250px; border: 1px solid oklch(30% 0.025 125); background: oklch(14% 0.014 135); color: oklch(94% 0.008 120); padding: 12px; font: 400 13px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; } .ds-product-media { height: 140px; padding: 9px; background: oklch(18% 0.012 130); color: oklch(82% 0.22 126); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-product:hover { border-color: oklch(73% 0.18 124); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-product:focus-within { outline: 3px solid oklch(90% 0.25 126); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Signal Tag
components.css: .ds-signal { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 7px; background: oklch(8% 0.012 130); color: oklch(82% 0.22 126); font: 800 9px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; }

narrative.overview: A premium game inventory screen made physical. Near-black technical surfaces, acid-lime interaction signals, industrial display lettering, and real product imagery create an immersive but disciplined shopping system.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Power Lime communicates interaction or status. It is never sprayed across large surfaces as decoration.

rules.name: The Case-Title Rule
rules.body: Display lettering is reserved for world names and decisive campaign statements.

rules.name: The Equipment-Bay Rule
rules.body: Products are mounted inside the interface. Soft floating cards are prohibited.

dos: Do use current Glitch Gear product photography and franchise imagery.
Do preserve obvious product, sizing, cart, search, and checkout affordances.
Do support keyboard navigation, visible focus, reduced motion, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
donts: Don't use generic Shopify templates, bright lifestyle-fashion minimalism, soft SaaS styling, or cartoonish gamer motifs.
Don't invent products, prices, sizing claims, policies, testimonials, or licensing relationships.
Don't imply that live payment processing is connected until the Shopify integration is configured.
